title: Supply Run to Dalhurst
description: Half the camp's saws are past sharpening and Tharin's own smith can't spare the steel to forge more, not this deep into the season. Halvard the Supplier in Dalhurst has held a tool shipment since summer, waiting on payment Tharin only now has the coin for. Bring it back before the felling crews start swinging dull blades out of frustration - or keep swinging them anyway and lose fingers to it.

objectives.description: Travel west to Dalhurst, past the Crossroads
Collect the tool shipment from Halvard - it's already paid for, so don't lose it
Get the tools back to Tharin before the crews run out of sharp ones

notes: Threat: Elder Moor's felling crews working dull tools toward an accident. Giver motive: second of Tharin's four trust tests - sending a stranger to collect a paid-for shipment from a stranger in Dalhurst. Consequence unwired; recorded for a later pass.
